hypotheses.name: DELETE_CONFIDENCE_STOP
hypotheses.mechanism: Remove confidence/entropy as a sufficient stop signal; stop only on verified action invariance or a separate cost/risk controller.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: calibrated confidence/risk bounds may be sufficient and cheaper
hypotheses.counterprediction: rare low-mass branch with distinct action defeats threshold
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current loop contract names adaptive recurrence but not an exact action-invariance stop law

hypotheses.name: IAC
hypotheses.mechanism: Project each current Hyperposition branch into complete action-semantic space; halt expensive recurrence when projected support is a singleton.
hypotheses.expected_gain: preserve epistemic uncertainty while deleting decision-irrelevant compute
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: no current measured loop-core stop primitive binds all live alternatives to complete action/effect semantics

hypotheses.name: ROBUST_ACTION_INTERVAL
hypotheses.mechanism: Use utility intervals per branch; halt when one action dominates under all admissible branch intervals.
hypotheses.expected_gain: handle utility uncertainty beyond exact equality

hypotheses.name: MYOPIC_VOC
hypotheses.mechanism: Think/query one more step only if estimated one-step value of computation exceeds cost.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: marginal utility is named but not implemented as this estimator

hypotheses.name: NONMYOPIC_VOC
hypotheses.mechanism: Plan over possible future computations and stop when optimal meta-policy says act.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: simple sufficient predicates plus fixed resource budgets

hypotheses.name: EVENT_TRIGGERED_RECURRENCE
hypotheses.mechanism: Treat material decision-boundary crossings as events; suppress recurrence between events.
hypotheses.counterprediction: subthreshold changes accumulate into later action switch

hypotheses.name: LYAPUNOV_HALT
hypotheses.mechanism: Reduce/halt recurrence when local contraction/stability and residual-pressure bounds are satisfied.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: diagnostics are hypotheses not a sufficient action criterion

hypotheses.name: PHASE_AWARE_ACTION_INVARIANCE
hypotheses.mechanism: For productive limit cycles, act only at phases where action projection is invariant across the orbit tube.
hypotheses.expected_gain: preserve useful cycles without requiring fixed point
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: TRSE/Poincare diagnostics plus ordinary action check
hypotheses.counterprediction: phase machinery adds no decision value
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: TRSE measures stability, not action invariance

hypotheses.name: ACTION_QUOTIENT_CACHE
hypotheses.mechanism: Cache branch->action projections keyed by state/decision/effect epochs and update incrementally.

hypotheses.name: DISTINCTION_PRESERVING_CONTEXT
hypotheses.mechanism: Allocate context only to evidence that can still split action projection.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: DCA arrived during run and now occupies it

hypotheses.name: COUNTERFACTUAL_ACTION_SENSITIVITY
hypotheses.mechanism: Continue only if a reachable intervention on unresolved variables can alter action semantics.
hypotheses.expected_gain: focus recurrence on variables with action consequence
hypotheses.counterprediction: inference costs more than reasoning saved
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: CARF is downstream credit, not prospective action sensitivity

hypotheses.name: BARRIER_TO_UNSAFE_ACTION
hypotheses.mechanism: Construct a control-barrier-like certificate that all live branches remain inside the same allowed-action region.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: effect gate checks actual request, not all unresolved branch projections

hypotheses.name: RISK_WEIGHTED_ACTION_CONE
hypotheses.mechanism: Approximate halt when probability mass of disagreeing actions is below explicit policy risk budget.
hypotheses.expected_gain: reduce compute where approximation is authorized
hypotheses.counterprediction: rare high-impact tail branch invalidates naive mass threshold
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: no explicit risk-budgeted approximate stop semantics

hypotheses.name: FIXED_BUDGET_NULL
hypotheses.mechanism: Use fixed recurrence/query budget and no new mechanism.
hypotheses.counterprediction: fixed budget wastes easy cases and underallocates ambiguous paths
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: fixed budgets are already a conventional baseline
